pages.title: Creation from Nothing
pages.text: $(thing)Creation from Nothing$()$(br2)Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe.
$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reheating, Vacuum Stability, Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Spin Foam Lattice.
